user.title: Newport News Waterworks
user.description: Sign in with your myservices.nnww.nnva.gov account.

verify.title: Verification code
verify.description: The portal emailed a 6-digit code to the address on your account. Enter it to finish signing in. You should only need to do this once.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in again
reauth_confirm.description: The portal needs you to sign in again as {username}. If it asks for a code, one will be emailed to you.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the portal
error.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Check the newest email from the portal; codes expire quickly.
